values.note: 219 utility sites in the west-shore campgrounds: Sunflower 61 and Scott Creek 60 by the entrance road, and the Russell Crites loops ~1.6 km north (Pintail Point 42, Crappie Cove 37, Quail Run 19). Gravel or concrete pads, mostly back-ins 30-90 ft, with a few pull-throughs. Plus primitive sites (Rabbit Ridge 42, Russell Crites 21) and the Saddle Ridge equestrian camp (22 W/E, 12 primitive) on the east side. A lone 110-ft back-in (Sunflower 120) is left out of the maximum.

note: West-shore campgrounds in two groups: Sunflower and Scott Creek by the entrance road, and the Russell Crites loops (Pintail Point, Crappie Cove, Quail Run) ~1.6 km north on the points, where the lake-edge sites are. SPLIT CANDIDATE (weak): the Russell Crites loops (Pintail Point 38.65767,-94.92105; Crappie Cove 38.65948,-94.92556; Quail Run 38.66019,-94.92216; 98 W/E) are 1.5-1.8 km north of Sunflower (38.64413,-94.92777) and Scott Creek (38.64442,-94.93248; 121 sites), and KDWP lists 'Russel Crites' and 'Scott Creek Campground' as separate areas. But imagery shows one park road from the southern loops running west then north to Russell Crites, and no separate public entrance; Overpass was down, so the road network is unconfirmed. Not split by the own-entrance test as far as I can tell.

Waterfront kept lakefront, but on the northern loops only: Pintail Point 065 and 067 end ~20-25 m from the riprap shore on open grass outside the loop road, and Quail Run 046-047 are ~40 m from the water at the head of their point. Sunflower (where the pin is) is 150-200 m back behind its loop road and prairie, so lakeview at best (27 of 61 'River/Lake View: Y'); Scott Creek's nearest pads are ~40 m from a wooded cove. If a split is made, the southern entry is lakeview.

Fee provenance is wrong on the site mix: 'KDWP's hillsdale page, all areas: 0 electric, 180 water and electric, 0 full hookups'. Sunflower has 61 full hookups (booking site), so the full_hookup +$15 tier applies. Fees left as recorded per AWH 2026-10-15.
